hook_text: Four people, one device, a term of arguments. One page stops them all.
clip_script: The brief. One sentence: design and make a device that warns a household when the tank is nearly empty, showing it clearly indoors, for a family without reliable electricity. What, for whom, where. No LED, no float switch, no circuit. Then specifications you can test: detect below one fifth, visible at ten metres in daylight, under half a milliamp on standby, a test button, survives rain, fits on a sill. Then constraints you cannot move: kit parts, 80 rand, weeks 3 to 9, no mains. Then say now how each will be tested. Everyone reads it. Everyone signs. When someone says make it beep, point at the page.
visual_style: Whiteboard sentence with four parts underlined; a numbered specification list with tick boxes; a constraints box with a padlock; four signatures at the bottom.
mood: Firm and friendly, like a team captain.
pacing: Sentence, no circuit, testable rules, fixed limits, tests now, sign.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and write three testable specifications for a night light.
